shapeSummary: Flat aluminum servo arm: 8 mm wide bar with a rounded end (R4) and a Ø10 mm hub at the other end. Four Ø4 mm through holes at 8 mm pitch (centers 13, 21, 29, 37 mm along Y). The hub center is at Y=5, 32 mm from the farthest hole. The plate is 4 mm thick and the hub is 7.6 mm thick, spanning Z -3.8 to 3.8. A Ø3 mm hole passes through the hub, with a Ø7 mm x 3.5 mm recess on the plate side. Overall bounds are about 10 x 41 x 7.6 mm.
warnings: The 25-tooth spline is not modeled; the Ø3 mm hole runs straight through the hub in its place.
The Ø7 mm recess depth of 3.5 mm is inferred from the section view dimension.
The 3.1 mm dimension is not tied clearly to a feature and is omitted.
The plate sits on the -Z side, with the hub projecting to +Z.
The Ø10 mm hub end is modeled as a full circle; the small notch where the hub meets the bar in the right view is omitted.
cadquery:
t=7.6
plate_t=4.0
hub_y=5.0
z0=-t/2
bar=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0).center(0,21).rect(8,32).extrude(plate_t)
top=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0).center(0,37).circle(4).extrude(plate_t)
hub=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0).center(0,hub_y).circle(5).extrude(t)
part=bar.union(top).union(hub)
holes=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0).pushPoints([(0,13),(0,21),(0,29),(0,37)]).circle(2).extrude(plate_t)
part=part.cut(holes)
recess=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0).center(0,hub_y).circle(3.5).extrude(3.5)
part=part.cut(recess)
bore=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0).center(0,hub_y).circle(1.5).extrude(t)
part=part.cut(bore)
